title: Choose Lehar's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Mandi Rate Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Mandi Rate Board
options.lineage: the painted 'aaj ka bhav' board at every mandi and kirana
options.thesis: Today's rates chalked up, the old one struck through, and a chalk line running from each rate to the holdings it touches.
materials: signwriter numerals (Teko, Kalam, Mukta: Indian foundries)
options.viewport: Slate shell: rate board on the left (crude, rupee, gas, metals as struck-and-rewritten rates), your holdings as a dense mosaic of name plates on the right, chalk ripple lines between them; 'Use my portfolio' in the top bar.
options.risk: Chalk can tip into a costume if the board gets texture, smudges or a wooden frame; the world must stay type, palette, density and the strike-and-ripple move only.

raised.raise: Every holding is a name plate with fixed furniture: name, your money, basis tag, always in the same place.
Holdings tile as a dense hairline mosaic, packed edge to edge, with no padded-card inflation.
One geometry: the chalk ripple paths are the same SVG that positions the highlight and the state.
Colour is quarantined to data: chalk colours appear only on rates, lines and exposed holdings; chrome stays slate and chalk-white.
Cost, revenue and both-ways are also encoded as solid, hatched and cross-hatched fills, so meaning survives without colour and on a muted screen share.

options.label: Monsoon Onset Map
options.lineage: IMD's monsoon onset isochrone map, redrawn every season
options.thesis: A move spreads through your portfolio the way the monsoon advances up the country: dated contour lines reaching holding after holding.
options.viewport: Light map ground: the chosen move at the 'Kerala' origin bottom-left, onset contours sweeping across a field of your holdings placed by exposure, with a dated legend strip.
options.risk: The most literal reading of 'Lehar' (wave/water); weather-map greens and contour lines are where many runs in this category land.

options.label: Jet-age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each move is a journey ticket: one coupon per leg, from the rate to your fund to the company to its costs.
options.viewport: A coupon book per move: the leg coupons tear off left to right; stale data is stamped EXPIRED; the wallet shows what remains.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the leg-by-leg coupon is exactly the look-through chain; loses on audience, since a 1960s Atlantic ticket is not this audience's object.
options.risk: Coupon chrome turns into a costume quickly on a working screen.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Holdings as a ranked roster of characters.
options.case: Fuses poorly: mascots collide with the 'no gamified fintech' constraint and blur the numbers.
options.kept: Fixed personal furniture on every plate.

options.label: Japanese High-Density Web
options.thesis: Every factor and holding on one packed screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the audience did not ask for density, and it drifts toward the consulting report they want to avoid.
options.kept: Hairline mosaic density without whitespace inflation.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Exposure factors as land lobes sized by your money.
options.case: Fuses poorly: organic lobe areas make amounts hard to read and compare.
options.kept: One geometry driving layout, art and state.

options.label: Lexicon Shoulder and Plate
options.thesis: Holdings as dictionary entries with colour only in plates.
options.viewport: A text column with a shoulder index.
options.case: Fuses poorly: reads as the dense report this audience wants to avoid.
options.kept: Colour quarantined to data plates; chrome stays monochrome.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: Exposure as hatch density; conflicts as crossed hatching.
options.viewport: Stacked sheets over a zone ramp.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the darkroom is foreign to this audience; its encoding is the useful part.
options.kept: Meaning carried by hatch pattern, not colour alone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean portfolio-analytics app, like the best Indian investing apps, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: KPI row, allocation donut, exposure bar chart and a holdings table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Tickertape or INDmoney by design.
